purpose: Qualify the remaining physical SWAP-to-Ribasim exchange responsibilities after external surface-water state ownership is established.

authorities.lower_exchange: F-PM08D2 exact-source extended drainage exchange inventory
authorities.availability: F-PM08D3 exact-source availability and mass inventory

Q3A_LOWER_EXCHANGE.ribasim_owner: accepted surface-water level/storage and available water
Q3A_LOWER_EXCHANGE.coupler_owner: feasibility resolution and exactly-once transfer receipt
required_cases: positive drainage with dynamic Ribasim level
negative infiltration with sufficient Ribasim storage
negative infiltration limited by external availability/supply
rejected coupled window leaves both accepted states unchanged
Q3A_LOWER_EXCHANGE.hard_rule: Never clip a negative exchange after SWAP has already accepted it. If external availability changes the realized exchange, SWAP and Ribasim must be recomposed from the same accepted origins so both accept the same realized transfer.
Q3A_LOWER_EXCHANGE.later_hold: mixed-sign multilevel legacy proportional scaling remains a separate scientific disposition

Q3B_TOP_AND_RAPID_EXCHANGE.QRapDra: SWAP-generated rapid/macropore inflow to surface water; publish as separately identified SWAP->Ribasim transfer
Q3B_TOP_AND_RAPID_EXCHANGE.RUNOTS_positive: SWAP runoff/top-surface inflow; map to Ribasim surface_runoff-class inflow with transfer identity
Q3B_TOP_AND_RAPID_EXCHANGE.RUNOTS_negative: surface-water inundation/withdrawal delivered to SWAP top boundary; book as Ribasim->SWAP transfer, not negative Ribasim surface_runoff
required_cases: rapid drainage only where process authority exists
combined ledger closure without double counting

mass_invariant: Every physical exchange identity is booked once on SWAP and once on Ribasim with opposite signs; Ribasim Basin forcing names are ledger endpoints, not independent process providers.
nonclaims: No claim that current RM13 drainage-off triangle qualifies Q3.
